entities.summary: Ayoub Ghadfa Drissi El Aissaoui is a Spanish boxer. He competed at the 2022 European Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the bronze medal in the super heavyweight event. He also competed at the 2024 Summer Olympics, winning the silver medal in the men's +92 kg event.
